title: Reptilians as dinosaur hybrids made by the Nordics

tellings.quote: slave race. Why not take dinosaurs and hybridize them genetically with themselves?

plain: The reptile-like beings of alien lore, called reptilians, were supposedly made by the Nordics, tall human-looking aliens, who genetically mixed dinosaurs with themselves to create a slave race. The philosopher Jason Jorjani lays this out, drawing on a work he credits called Closer Encounters, and puts it as a question: why not take dinosaurs and hybridize them? If true, it would make one kind of alien the creation of another.
